messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: P1 — model-load failures spiking in us-west-2 (GPU pool). Symptoms: OOM at model init, deserialization errors, compile timeouts, CUDA driver resets. Affected endpoint: /v1/generate. Details: <https://internal/ops/INC-8007>
lina: I'm taking primary. Gathering warmup + kernel logs from nodes 12-18, will post findings.
raj: I already pulled warmup logs — seeing repeated 'deserialize: checksum mismatch' followed by 'compile timeout (30s)'. Also multiple 'CUDA kernel launch failed: driver reset' on gpu-12 and gpu-14.
michael: Any clear customer impact? are we seeing increased 5xxs or latency from the gateway?
lina: Edge metrics: ~0.6% uptick in 5xx across the fleet. One enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) experiencing ~2% 503s on their routes. No full outage but elevated latency for some requests.
sre-bot: Paging eng-oncall @lina @raj — please acknowledge and coordinate mitigation.
lina: acked. Mitigation plan (short): 1) divert portion of traffic to fallback smaller model 2) evict KVCaches on affected nodes to free memory 3) rollback recent artifact if manifest/deserialize is root cause 4) monitor and communicate.
raj: K/V eviction started on nodes 12-18 to drop prefix caches and free commit RAM:
```
./tools/kv_evict --nodes 12..18 --confirm
```
infra-bot: Eviction job accepted: job_id=evict-8007, nodes=12-18. Estimated completion ~45s.
lina: Kicking a canary reroute to model "small-2026-02" at 10% -> 50% to reduce pressure while preserving perf testing.
```
# internal routing API
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/routes/adjust \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","target_model":"small-2026-02","weight_percent":50}'
```
michael: Also recommend bumping warmup compile timeout to 60s and temporarily disabling aggressive JIT compilation for this model to avoid timeouts.
raj: Good call. Investigation: the new quantized artifact pushed earlier today had a truncated manifest entry which caused extra deserialization retries and higher memory churn. Initiating rollback to artifact@20260202.
infra-bot: Rollback initiated on deployment group model-artifacts-prod -> version artifact@20260202. Rolling out across affected shards.
lina: Rollback completed on 14/16 nodes. Warmup health checks: 14/16 ok, 2 still initializing but progressing. 5xx rate trending down towards baseline.
support-acme: Notifying AcmeCorp support/engineering with current status and ETA. Will provide a short blurb for their SREs.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (canary routing, kv eviction, rollback). Severity remains P1 while we verify stability. Incident owner: raj. Postmortem owner: raj. Next update in 15m or on major state change.
raj: Follow-ups (post-incident): add manifest checksum + size validation into artifact CI, extend warmup/compile metrics (track deserialize retries + compile-time percentile), add auto-rollback trigger when deserialize errors > threshold, and improve per-node paging alarms.
lina: Agree. I'll update the runbook with the eviction + canary steps and monitor for the next 2 hours. :thumbsup:
